TIDRADIO TD-H9 · USB-C

Firmware updater

We’ll walk through installing H9 Toolbox Firmware or restoring stock v1.0.38, one step at a time.

  2. 2Connect
  3. 3Firmware

Step 1 of 6

Let’s get your radio ready

Grab your TD-H9 and a data-capable USB-C cable. We’ll check your browser first, then back up the radio before installing.

  • TD-H9 radioStart with a charged battery.
  • USB-C data cableUse a cable that can transfer files.
  • Chrome or EdgeOpen this page on a computer.
Checking whether your browser supports USB updates…
Having trouble with your browser?

If you’re on a phone or tablet, send this page’s link to your computer. If you’re using Safari or Firefox, switch to Chrome or Edge on your computer.

Already using Chrome or Edge? Open this page in a regular browser tab and make sure your browser is up to date. If you’re on a work or school computer, try a personal computer. Work or school settings can block USB access.

If you need to recover your radio after a failed update, see the TD-H9 recovery guide.

Experimental firmware. A failed update can leave the radio unable to boot. Have a recovery method ready before you start. The browser install and restore flow was tested on one TD-H9 from macOS.

Step 2 of 6

Connect in update mode

Disconnected
  1. Turn the radio off and plug it into your computer with a data-capable USB-C cable.
  2. Hold PTT + 2 while powering on. Look for a blank screen and a green top LED.
  3. Click Connect radio and select the JieLi device in the browser’s USB picker.
The radio isn’t showing up

If the screen lights up normally, turn the radio off and repeat PTT + 2 as you turn it on. If the picker is empty, try another data cable or a port directly on the computer, then reopen the picker.

If the picker won’t open or access is denied, return to the browser check on step 1. A managed device can block USB access. Close other tabs or desktop flashers that may be using the radio.

Step 3 of 6

Choose your firmware

Choose H9 Toolbox for the on-radio app menu. Choose stock to install the official Type-C v1.0.38 firmware.

H9 Toolbox Firmware v0.1.5Selected Includes the app loader, Bluetooth packet support, and an optional APRS modem update.
Stock Type-C v1.0.38Selected Fetches and verifies the official package from the TDH9 GitHub mirror.

No firmware selected

The download or file check failed

Check your internet connection and try loading the package again. If GitHub is unavailable, choose a local copy of the official Type-C v1.0.38 .fw file. This updater checks the exact package before installing it.

Step 4 of 6

Save a recovery backup

Click Backup radio and keep the downloaded .h9hid file. A known firmware image can take seconds to back up. Recovering an unfamiliar image can take about an hour.

Backup stalled or download missing

Keep the radio powered on and connected while the backup is running. If the backup stops, check the cable and use step 2 to reconnect in update mode. Check your browser’s downloads for the .h9hid file before moving on.

The recovery file covers accessible firmware. The protected boot region is outside the backup. Save your channels and settings separately with the Bluetooth programmer.

Use a saved restore point

You can choose a compatible .h9hid or raw .bin backup to restore. Known H9 Toolbox builds use verified stock v1.0.38 as the default restore point.

No backup selected. You can create one above.

Step 5 of 6

Install and verify

Keep USB connected and the radio powered on. We’ll check the radio first, write the sectors that need updating, then verify every firmware sector. H9 Toolbox Firmware also stages the optional APRS modem update if space is available.

Restore writes the main firmware from your backup. The staged file and APRS modem stay as they are.

0%
The update stopped or the check failed

Keep the selected firmware and original backup. If the radio disconnected, go back to step 2 and reconnect using PTT + 2, then return here. If the preflight check says the backup does not match, use step 4 to select the original backup from this radio.

The updater checks the radio again before writing. For an interrupted write, keep this browser session and use the same firmware and restore point. If Install is disabled after reconnecting, use the original recovery file and choose Restore backup. If the radio still won’t connect or start, see the TD-H9 recovery guide.

Step 6 of 6

Restart your radio

The APRS staging area is occupied. Its contents were preserved. Skip the keypad update on this radio.

Unlock KISS TNC (optional)

The APRS update was staged and verified. You can now finish from the radio keypad.

  1. When the USB install finishes, unplug the cable and turn the radio off.
  2. Hold the side PTT (talk) button and the keypad 7 together while turning the radio on. Let go when the screen says APRS Update.
  3. Press Menu once and let go. At APRS STAGE READY, press Menu a second time to write the modem firmware. Leave the radio on until it shows APRS BOOT VERIFIED. Press Back from the ready screen if you want to leave without writing.
  4. Turn the radio off and back on normally. In APRS Info, look for V1.0.15X.
  5. Turn on Bluetooth on the radio. Download and unzip the bridge on your computer, open the README, and follow the steps to connect your packet program.
Download KISS bridge and README

The bridge connects the radio over Bluetooth and provides direct KISS TCP plus built-in AGWPE for Pat and Paracon. The ZIP includes setup instructions.

If APRS Info stays on Querying… after a normal restart, use the Windows APRS recovery instructions.

The radio won’t start or the app menu is missing

Unplug USB, then switch the radio off and back on without holding any buttons. If the radio still won’t start, follow the TD-H9 recovery guide.

After installing H9 Toolbox Firmware, wait for the channel screen and hold Back to open the app menu. If the App Manager can’t connect, enable Bluetooth on the computer and disconnect the radio from other apps.
